# Velio

> Cycling route planner on open data for Spain, Portugal and Andorra. Tell it how far and how much climbing: it draws a loop back to your door, or a route through your stops, and scores it before you ride, with the surface kilometre by kilometre, the traffic, the climbing and any road ridden twice. Free, with no ads.

Velio is built and run by Diego Sanchez as a personal project. Routing runs on Valhalla over OpenStreetMap data, and elevation comes from the Copernicus DEM GLO-30 at 30 m. The web app is in English and Spanish.

- Loops: choose the distance, the climbing (flat, rolling or hilly) and the bike (road, city, gravel or mountain); compare up to four loops.
- Point-to-point routes through up to 20 stops, with up to two scored alternatives.
- A cycling score out of 10 (distance accuracy, traffic, surface for the bike, climbing, repeated road), the surface kilometre by kilometre and a real elevation profile.
- Analyse any GPX or encoded polyline, save routes, and export them as GPX with elevation or as GeoJSON.
- Coverage: Spain (Canary Islands included), Portugal (Azores and Madeira included) and Andorra; riders can ask for their country.

## Use it

- [Velio](https://velio.cub1z.es/): landing page in English, with how it works and the FAQ.
- [Velio en español](https://velio.cub1z.es/es): the same page in Spanish.
- [Create an account](https://velio.cub1z.es/register): free sign-up with an email or Google; the planner is behind the login.

## Policies

- [Privacy policy](https://velio.cub1z.es/privacy): what Velio stores, why, and how to delete it.
- [Terms of service](https://velio.cub1z.es/terms): the rules for using Velio and checking routes before riding.
